en.headline: CUHK to bid for land in Hung Shui Kiu University Town
en.dek: Vice-Chancellor Dennis Lo said the university plans to compete for one of the first sites, citing expansion opportunities despite staggered tenders and high costs.
body: The Chinese University of Hong Kong intends to bid for one of the first three campus sites in the Hung Shui Kiu University Town of the Northern Metropolis, Vice-Chancellor Professor Dennis Lo said in comments published on Tuesday.

Lo told Ming Pao that the project offered the university a rare chance to expand beyond its current relatively small campus. He noted that the government’s plan to tender the three sites—in Hung Shui Kiu, San Tin and Ta Kwu Ling—at different times would complicate coordination among institutions.

On funding, Lo said CUHK would proceed prudently. The government has earmarked HK$10 billion in loans to support campus development at the university town, though borrowing limits and high construction costs remain constraints. Institutions must submit applications by the end of December.

zh.headline: 中大擬競投洪水橋大學城首批土地
zh.dek: 校長盧煜明表示大學計劃競投其中一個首批校舍用地，認為是擴大校園的機會，惟分批招標及成本高昂構成挑戰。
body: 香港中文大學校長盧煜明周二表示，大學擬競投北都大學城洪水橋首批三個校舍用地其中之一。
盧煜明在明報專訪中指，現時校園規模較小，北都大學城提供難得機會擴大足跡。他指出政府分批招標洪水橋、新田及打鼓嶺三個用地，令院校之間的規劃與合作較為困難。
在融資方面，盧煜明表示中大會審慎行事。政府已預留100億元貸款支持大學城發展，但借款有上限，建造成本亦高。院校須於12月底前提交申請。
